html:
This tool is a visual representation, designed to illustrate MMA Judging concepts

It emphasizes the priorities of judging criteri, how to apply them to fighting techniques, to determine your score. It is not intended to illustrate accurate values of techniques but more so, the relative values for scoring

It shows various levels of Dominance and how it interacts with Duration, to justify a 10-8 score


Option 1: Clean and Professional (Best for documentation or a tool intro)

"This interactive tool visualizes MMA judging concepts. It highlights the hierarchy of scoring criteria, demonstrates how to apply them to specific techniques, and focuses on relative values rather than absolute technical worth. By showing how dominance and duration interact, the model helps explain when a round warrants a 10-8 score."

Option 2: Concise and Direct (Best for a UI tooltip, app description, or subtitle)

"This visual guide illustrates MMA scoring principles. It breaks down judging priorities, relative technique weights, and the interplay between dominance and duration required for a 10-8 round."

Option 3: Conversational and Educational (Best for a blog post or video explanation)

"Think of this tool as a visual breakdown of how MMA fights are scored. Instead of measuring the exact power of individual moves, it compares their relative value, emphasizes judging priorities, and maps out how sustained dominance over time builds a case for a 10-8 round."

Option 4: Formal / Official Tone (Closer to a rulebook or academic breakdown)

"Designed as a conceptual model for MMA judging, this tool outlines the priority of evaluation criteria and their practical application to fighting techniques. It illustrates relative scoring weights rather than absolute physical metrics, mapping the relationship between dominance and duration to justify a 10-8 round."
